decisions.reason: A PETG thermoforming blank is a low-cost addition to an established consumables range with steady lab demand, so keeping the option open costs little even though it no longer appears on the website.

The lacquer was only ever mentioned on the website and has not been visible since, which suggests its uptake in printing workflows has not materialized, so its resources are better used for core digital manufacturing.
Custom earmolds run on the firm's core custom-device production for hearing-care retailers, so carrying cost stays low and demand remains structurally stable despite the weak web presence.
Custom hearing protection shares the same production base and keeps a cheap option open on occupational-safety growth, so it is not worth abandoning yet despite limited visibility.
